detail.pinUnavailable: PIN inatumizidwa pamene munagula ticket iyi. Onani messages zanu ngati mukufuna.
detail.offlineBody: Tikugwiritsa cached entry codes. Sync mukabwerera online pa codes zatsopano.

cancel.heading: Cancel kapena opt out
cancel.policy: Kupitirira masiku 7 event isanayambe: full refund minus 5% admin fee. 1–7 days: 50% refund. Pansi pa maola 24: palibe refund (mutha kutransfer). Refunds zimaqueue, sizilipidwa nthawi yomweyo.
cancel.queued: Refund ya {amount} yaqueue. Mudzalipidwa pa original mobile-money rail.
cancel.voidedNoRefund: Ticket yavoided. Palibe refund mu window iyi.
cancel.tooLate: Ticket iyi singacancelled pa refund. Transfer m'malo mwake.
cancel.noReschedule: Event iyi sinasinthidwe nthawi, palibe choti muopt out.

access.title: Event access
access.intro: If you received an event access code, enter it below to continue.

errors.invalid: The event is unavailable or that access code is invalid.

transfer.title: Transfer ticket
transfer.subtitle: Tumizani ticket iyi kwa bwenzi free. Adzalowa ndi nambala ya foni pansipa kuti apeze.
transfer.successBody: Tawadziwitsa {phone}. Angapeze ticket iyi polowa ndi nambala ija.

errors.phoneMismatch: Lowani ndi nambala ya foni yomwe ticket inatumizidwa.

teamAccept.title: Lowani pa event team
teamAccept.intro: Gwiritsani one-time token yomwe organiser anakupatsani. Lowani ndi nambala ya foni yomwe anakuitanira.
teamAccept.success: Tsopano muli pa door team ya event iyi.
teamAccept.failed: Invite iyi si valid, yaexpired, kapena inatumizidwa ku nambala ina.
